dct_description_sm: Using a survey research design with a convenience sample, the investigators will evaluate discharge teaching in the Pediatric Cardiology Unit at the Stollery Children's Hospital. The survey tool will provide anonymous data from parents related to their children's hospitalization and discharge from hospital.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Assessment of Discharge Process from the Pediatric Cardiology Unit
